title: nlp.alert.v1
description: Phase 10 §10.11: NLP-plane observability envelope. Narrow alert channel for NLP-class events that need operator visibility WITHOUT widening the §7.4 sec.alert.v1 producer-set (which is bounded to sec.* + maint.* agents). `kind` is an open enum (per §7.4 doctrine: producers emit only known kinds, consumers tolerate unknown kinds and route by `severity`). Mirrors ai/swarm/agents/nlp/payloads.py::NlpAlert (when implemented). Debounced via swarm.sdk.AlertDebouncer.

schema_version.description: Payload schema version. 1 = baseline schema. When absent, consumers treat the payload as version 1 for backward compatibility.

kind.description: Open enum (mirrors §7.4 doctrine). Known NLP kinds include: lexicon_unreadable, dictionary_overflow, pii_detected_in_input, nlp_humanizer_drift, nlp_pii_in_answer, nlp_proofreader_failed, intent_classifier_unavailable, nlp_predict_timeout, nlp_bus_down, nlp_queue_pressure, nlp_spool_overflow, nlp_secondary_injection_hit, nlp_intent_model_sha_mismatch, nlp_lexicon_atomic_swap_failed, lexicon_collision_load_high, nlp_singleflight_overflow, nlp_template_render_used_raw_user_text, nlp_spool_replay_text_unavailable, nlp_citation_signature_verify_failed, nlp_cold_start_timeout, nlp_lexicon_feed_schema_too_new, nlp_lexicon_feed_signature_invalid, lexicon_coverage_below_floor, lexicon_stale, nlp_consensus_smoke_failed, humanizer_subprocess_died, nlp_compatibility_quartet_mismatch, nlp_classifier_extractor_skew_high, conversation_context_cleared_after_block, streaming_humanizer_chunk_blocked, nlp_slur_in_input, nlp_repair_density_anomaly, nlp_tenant_intake_abuse, nlp_abuse_did_you_mean_anomaly, nlp_abuse_style_shift, nlp_abuse_shadow_concentration, nlp_abuse_account_farm, calibration_horizon_mismatch, lexicon_swap_late, lexicon_swap_lag_drained_to_503, nlp_complaint_trace_drift, nlp_kill_pattern_stale_armed_at_boot, nlp_preview_token_budget_exhausted_per_operator, nlp_canary_rolled_back, nlp_weekly_eval_regression, nlp_humanizer_pod_budget_exceeded, nlp_l1_cache_signature_invalid, nlp_safe_mode_active, excessive_combining_marks, nlp_pii_in_input_tc_kimlik, nlp_pii_in_input_iban, nlp_pii_in_input_phone, nlp_pii_in_input_plate, nlp_pii_in_input_vkn, nlp_shout_rate_anomaly_per_subject, lexicon_rebuild_queue_overflow, nlp_request_budget_exhausted, sarcasm_cue_rate_drift, tr_output_grammar_fallback_used, tr_output_grammar_validator_killswitch_engaged, negation_scope_distribution_drift, refusal_reason_rate_spike, lexicon_catalog_alias_conflict, outbound_checksum_mismatch, lexicon_canary_disagreement_above_threshold, wh_prior_drift, politeness_distribution_drift, cache_subject_key_collision. The producer-side AST scan enforces emission sites use only documented kinds.

producer.description: Agent that emitted this alert (e.g., nlp.intent.v1, nlp.proofreader.v1, nlp.dispatcher.v1, nlp.abuse.v1, nlp.gossip_aggregator.v1).

severity.description: Alert severity. Critical bypasses the §10.11 AlertDebouncer gate.

source.description: NLP agent that emitted this alert (e.g., nlp.intent.v1, nlp.proofreader.v1, nlp.dispatcher.v1).

reason.description: Free-form human-readable diagnostic. Capped at 1024 chars by producers. No PII (mirrors sec.alert.v1 discipline).

subject.description: Optional subject (e.g., lexicon_file_name, intent_class). Payload-only — never a metric label dimension (cardinality bound).

request_id.description: Round-trips from qa.request.v1 when the alert is tied to a specific request.

qa_correlation_id.description: Round-trips from the §10.6 dispatch correlation when available.

details.description: Structured diagnostic details (e.g., {lexicon_file, entry_count, rss_mb}). Capped at 2 KB JSON serialized. No PII.

emitted_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the alert was emitted.
